root: ^"Henry, you know better than to call me that."
^"And YOU know better than to call me Henry."
^(Both chuckle.) "It’s been far too long, darling. And to humor you I’ve been absolutely dreadful"
^Don Pappardelle is known for his exports and exterminations, not for being a good husband. "Trouble in paradise?"
^"... I found the other woman. Some poor, sweet twenty-something."
^"When I heard, I nearly chucked my pocketbook into the river."

Surprised: ^"Can’t be surprised, of course. But it hurts, all the same... I had a life before the Don, you know."
^"Do I ever!! I remember when every club promoter in the city would saw a leg off just to hear you sing."
^"And now... look at me! I’m washed up!!"
^"Hank? Will you do me a favor?"

c-0: ^"I dont like where this is going"
^"It’s seamless. With the Tagliatelle land grab, he’ll be swimming with the fishes sooner than Saint Patrick’s.
^We’ll just be expediting the process. Besides, you won’t be implicated."
